interpretation: These examples are prospective operationalizations of source claims and potential contradictions, not empirically demonstrated causal correlates.
admission_policy: Use only exact answer quotes from blinded respondents; never ask for birth/chart clues.
No fact inferred merely from job/sex/occupation/age/education or prompt premise.
A matched repeated counterexample can challenge a positive claim; unknown and chart absence are not negative scores.
Allow partial conditional coding and abstain; do not transform missing into opposite pole.
Dependent questions count as one evidence family, not multiple independent hits.
Blinded neutral coder must not see target features, rule weights, true-chart rank, or expected answers.
No numeric weights or probabilities until independently estimated from a separate training cohort and frozen.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Repeated real role entry becomes easier or more effective when invited on the basis of specific recognized contribution, contrasted with matched uninvited advice.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Matched self-initiated/solicited contributions show no invitation-related difference across occasions.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Praise without invitation; ordinary politeness; role hierarchy; one anecdote without counterfactual.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: A subtle bodily signal usually precedes explicit reasoning on real consequential decisions, is immediate and does not recur with deliberation.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Matched real choices are repeatedly decided only after delayed emotional shifts, with no reported early bodily signal.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Learned bodily vocabulary; obvious danger cues; general anxious feelings; theoretical authority labels.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: The reported yes/no about real important choices predictably changes as emotions settle over time rather than feeling decisively clear at the outset.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Decisions across matched important choices have immediate stable clarity despite emotional changes.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: More information arriving over time; avoidance of accountability; minor preferences.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Person reports mood intensification in proximity to an upset other, then return toward baseline after separation in comparable situations.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: No detectable affective shifts across repeated exposure to others’ strong moods, with context and relationship controlled.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: General compassion, interpersonal conflict directed at participant, preexisting mood, acute mental-health changes.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Imposed urgency changes felt pressure/pace despite constant objective deadline, and pressure drops when interpersonal urgency is removed.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Equal objective deadlines and workload produce similar pace despite different external urgency signals across cases.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Urgent requests with genuine penalties; practical prioritization; medical anxiety.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Reports sustainable interest-matched ordinary work compared with similarly engaged peers, with clear duration and recovery qualifiers.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Repeating large depletion during ordinary feasible workloads despite sleep, health, motivation and workload matching.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Extraordinary all-night work, health or sleep disorders, noncomparable work intensity, success/self-image.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Freely adopted important feasible commitments are repeatedly delivered after enthusiasm wanes, with separately reported selection threshold.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Repeated failures of deeply chosen feasible important promises without changed conditions or external obstacles.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Casual favors, imposed duties, coercion, inaccessible resources and moral judgments.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Repeatedly initiates optional fine-detail refinement after competence is adequate and despite no external reward, not only to prevent known mistakes.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Across valued skills, no tendency toward voluntary refinement once sufficient for the purpose.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Required rehearsal, performance pressure, one language-learning example, perfectionism label alone.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: New personally generated insight is frequently translated into a communicable explanation and changes others’ understanding according to actual examples.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Insights are not expressed or repeatedly fail to become communicable even in receptive contexts.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Summarizing public information, courtesy explanations, teacher title, success judged by speaker alone.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Notices recurring correctable flaws and feels improvement impulse across real stakes, independent of whether speaking up would be appreciated.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Consistently lacks improvement impulse for noticed consequential, feasible-to-correct problems.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: One trivial error, duty-bound correction, criticism for status, objective harm judgments after the fact.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Sustains stationary concentration on intrinsically valuable tasks over time with controls for interests and interruptions.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Repeated inability to remain on any meaningful interest-matched task despite suitable conditions.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: Ability to resume after interruption, hyperfocus on entertainment, sleep/health factors, motivational inconsistency.

hypotheses.positive_evidence_if_multiple_situations: Narrative reports stable personally chosen direction across materially different life contexts and relationships.
hypotheses.possible_counterevidence_not_automatic_i: Multiple concrete life contexts show radically externally determined direction changes without self-directed continuity.
hypotheses.must_abstain_if: A single fixed career label, moral desirability of consistency, personality inventory self-description without examples.
